name: Kagura Ayuri
source:
Yoshiaki's stepmother. She is calm and natural-looking. Although she has a fortune left by her husband, she does not lead a lavish life, and Ayuri herself works. Since her husband's death, she has been using her body to her advantage.
She looks young for her age and has a buxom body.
She is good at housework in general.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070827142514/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/noise/noise_char.html]official site[/url]]
